contractSummary: Verify that a same-repository draft pull request automatically runs quality checks and refreshes one stable Cloudflare Pages preview while production remains separate and manual.
task: Create the test pull request, diagnose and repair any preview workflow failure, verify the successful GitHub Actions run and stable preview in a browser, and preserve the preview-versus-production boundary.
sanitizedDiff: The task created a draft pull request, added validation for explicit Wrangler installation settings, configured the Cloudflare deployment action to use npm with Wrangler 4.115.0, and verified a successful retry. No production trigger or merge was added.
evidence: Draft pull request #1 was created from the isolated feature branch into main and remains not ready for merge.
Workflow run #1 passed dependency installation, tests, type checking, and the production build; it failed only while pnpm blocked build scripts for a temporarily installed Wrangler dependency.
A failing static validator reproduced the missing explicit package manager and Wrangler version before the workflow was changed.
The workflow now selects npm for the deployment action and pins Wrangler 4.115.0.
The static workflow validator, 3 test files with 8 tests, type checking, and the production build all passed locally after the repair.
Workflow run #2 was triggered automatically by the pull request synchronize event and completed successfully in 58 seconds.
The stable preview URL was refreshed after the successful run and showed the expected application title, growth content, and four primary navigation destinations.
No production workflow, production Pages project, custom domain, family photo, or merge was created or triggered.
